text:
Maya Patel: Kickoff for the April newsletter welcome drip. Goal: 1st successful call + identify high-intent. Quick plan below.
Jon Rivera: Cohorts?
Maya Patel: product-explorer, integrator, enterprise-eval. Sheet: https://docs.google.com/sheet/example (tab 'apr-welcome')
Sophia Lee: Product-explorer: 3 emails over 7 days, CTA = playground. Integrator: checklist + SDK snippets + webinar invite on day 4.
Oliver Grant: Enterprise-eval needs SDR routing. Suggest webhook when engagement_score >= 2.
Maya Patel: Webhook example:

```
POST /hooks/sdr
{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "cohort": "{{cohort}}",
  "engagement_score": {{score}},
  "campaign": "apr_welcome"
}
```

Jon Rivera: Define engagement_score = clicks >=2 OR reply OR scheduler_click. Add 14d suppression after conversion.
Liam Chen: Throttle sends by domain and stagger by timezone for deliverability. Also include 5% holdout for baseline.
Sophia Lee: Subject ideas: "Welcome to Redwood  Start in 5 min", "Try Redwood: quickstart guide". I'll draft copy for integrator + enterprise.
Oliver Grant: I'll create SFDC queue & mapping. Will run a preview send to QA once copy is in.
OpsBot: Campaign created: cmp_apr_2026_17, staging_send=2026-04-01T16:00:00Z, production_send=2026-04-02T16:00:00Z
Maya Patel: I'll update sheet with routing rules, cadence, and ESP A/B cells by Monday.
Jon Rivera: Good. Owners locked: copy - Sophia/Maya, delivery checks - Oliver/Liam.
Liam Chen: Add 1-click rating on email 3 and map to engagement_score for quick signal.
Maya Patel: Will do. Ping me if you want subject swaps.
Sophia Lee: Drafts ETA Tue EOD.
Oliver Grant: I'll schedule the deliverability preview after drafts.
Jon Rivera: If no blockers, staging send next Tue. :thumbsup:
